description: This PHP source file defines the PasswordEnforceException class within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. The class extends AuthenticationException and implements RedirectableException, providing functionality related to password enforcement, including generating a reset code and redirect URL for weak passwords.

classes.name: PasswordEnforceException
classes.description: A custom exception class that handles password enforcement issues, capable of generating a reset code and providing a redirection URL for password recovery.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the exception with a name and message.

methods.name: generateResetCode
methods.description: Generates and stores a password reset code by logging a password enforce request via the password strength service.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to redirect the user to the password reset page with the reset code appended.
